keyPoints.en: Belief in the messengers is the 4th pillar of iman.
keyPoints.bm: Beriman kepada rasul ialah rukun iman ke-4.

keyPoints.en: A rasul receives revelation and must convey it; every rasul is a nabi.
keyPoints.bm: Rasul menerima wahyu dan wajib menyampaikannya; setiap rasul ialah nabi.

keyPoints.en: 25 messengers are named in the Quran; Ulul Azmi: Nuh, Ibrahim, Musa, Isa, Muhammad.
keyPoints.bm: 25 rasul disebut dalam al-Quran; Ulul Azmi: Nuh, Ibrahim, Musa, Isa, Muhammad.

keyPoints.en: Wajib: siddiq, amanah, tabligh, fatanah. Mustahil: kizib, khianat, kitman, baladah.
keyPoints.bm: Wajib: siddiq, amanah, tabligh, fatanah. Mustahil: kizib, khianat, kitman, baladah.

keyPoints.en: Harus: normal human traits (eating, sleeping, illness) that do not lower their status.
keyPoints.bm: Harus: sifat manusia biasa (makan, tidur, sakit) yang tidak merendahkan martabat.

tip.en: Learn each wajib attribute together with its mustahil opposite.
tip.bm: Hafal setiap sifat wajib bersama lawan mustahilnya.

keyPoints.en: Muhammad ﷺ is the final messenger (khatamun nabiyyin, al-Ahzab: 40).
keyPoints.bm: Muhammad ﷺ rasul terakhir (khatamun nabiyyin, al-Ahzab: 40).

keyPoints.en: Greatest miracle: the Quran; others include Israk Mikraj.
keyPoints.bm: Mukjizat terbesar: al-Quran; lain-lain termasuk Israk Mikraj.

keyPoints.en: Show love by following his sunnah and character.
keyPoints.bm: Zahirkan kasih dengan mengikuti sunnah dan akhlak baginda.
